status: Frozen private candidate; 123 final cases passed across seven suites, zero failures/skips. No production/source or shared build writes.
cohort: cohort-manifest.json; copied completed180 source+archives, no ABI/layout changes; linked only copied archives
engineScope: AgentEngine.cpp::requestModel only; keeps boundary summary string outside user converter, inserts same memory content after preparation before file/skill/user parts. No AgentEngine.h/harness/Claude telemetry hunk.
behavior: HTTP current enabled catalog re-resolution for every retained user invocation, current file bytes cached only during one request; restart/fork keeps canonical links, not stale skill bodies.
Frontmatter removed/empty bodies omitted, slash IDs resolve exact first then one percent decode for native old links, escaped CDATA wrapper. Existing native bare /name shortcut retained.
ContextLoader::nativeSystemContext excludes duplicate current invocation body; externalHarnessContext path unchanged.
Whole transient conversion fails before network on 1Mi character cumulative skill output bound, preserving canonical history.
/side is exact action-only completion for top-level owner chats; removes query and uses existing child fork with draft/session CAS, current-owner checks, no send.
Popup invalidation commits state before terminal hide; completion helpers guard replacement/deletion after hide. Action text notifications are delivered after Qt document editing returns.
Only changed legacy fixture assertion expects slash-command rather than old invoked_skill and additionally asserts old duplicate absent.
beforeEvidence: before.txt: actual MainWindow missing skill on second request and absent /side both reproduced (2pass/2fail).
first-after.txt: replay fixed; exact action descriptor initially filtered by generic insert-text validation (3pass/1fail), fixed for command:side only.
hide-reentry-before.txt: current context replaced during popup Hide still accepted old action (2pass/1fail), guarded after terminal invalidation.
delete-reentry-stack.txt: synchronous textChanged observer deleting owner caused QTextDocument::finishEdit crash; fixed via terminal publication after guarded edit; final host case passes.
host-expanded.txt: fork count assertion saw valid extra title utility request; final test asserts exact three streamed requests and fork payload separately.

excludedExperiment.result: Direct synchronous deletion of owning MainWindow from child QEvent::Hide filter crashes inside Qt QWidgetPrivate::hideChildren; post-hide QPointer cannot repair toolkit frame. Recorded as unsupported synchronous event-filter receiver destruction, not declared fixed. Final tests instead validate normal close/deleteLater plus context replacement and public textChanged owner deletion. No popup lifetime redesign.

limits: Builtins are not packaged by this patch. Watch is ready for a tested resource slice; Preview needs documented obsolete overwriteFile recipe mapping; Plan/Implement require plans owner storage; Debug requires logIngest/logs; Learn global writes lack approved writable mount.
Reference ACP prompt builder does not use the HTTP per-message converter. Existing external invoked context retained unchanged, no repeated transcript or fabricated native APIs.
Enabled registry is host configured at turn start; file bodies re-read each HTTP request. Live mid-turn catalog/preferences rediscovery is not added by this patch.
Native strict UTF8 and bounded frontmatter parser remain deliberate differences from Node/gray-matter; no encoding relaxation.
Percent-encoded UI path links remain unchanged; existing scoped clicked-link decoder and raw attachment paths continue working.
No universal full skills/context/tool parity claim; no real credentials, user profiles, live model calls or desktop actions.
